as_told.title: Tesla and Townsend Brown worked together on anti-gravity

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla and Thomas Townsend Brown, an American researcher said to have worked on anti-gravity, supposedly worked together sometime between the 1920s and 1940s, and the evidence is said to come from foreign intelligence, not American sources. Harold Malmgren, a former presidential advisor, recalls asking where the finding came from and getting the answer "intelligence", followed by "I did not get that from any US source." The tellings disagree on who said that line: one credits Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure, while another gives it to Malmgren himself and frames the work as anti-gravity research.
